notes: Yes: Hu and Tang (arXiv:2607.06480, 2026) prove mr = n-2k+2 over every infinite field for k >= 2, n >= 2k-1. Upper bound re-derived as the divided-difference form L(q_S q_T), q_S = prod over i not in S of (x - t_i); certificate/check_construction.py checks pattern and rank exactly for (5,2),(6,2),(7,3),(8,3),(9,3),(9,4),(10,4). Outside Lean: the whole argument (citation; the script covers only the listed cases of the upper bound).

sources.cite: T. Hu, Q. Tang, Minimum-rank parameters of complements of threshold Kneser graphs, arXiv:2607.06480 (2026)
sources.what: mr of the complement of KG(n,k) equals n-2k+2 over every infinite field; answers the AIM question
